LanguageData.PhobosBulk_GizmoPourDesc: Pour what {HOLD} holds into another bin, tank or cart within {CELLS} cells, or onto the ground beside it.\n\nHolding: {WHAT}
LanguageData.PhobosBulk_GizmoStopDesc: Stop {HOLD} pouring. What has been poured stays where it went.
LanguageData.PhobosBulk_PourOnGround: Pour onto the ground beside it
LanguageData.PhobosBulk_DeconstructWarning: {HOLD} still holds {WHAT}. Taken down as it is, at most {HEAPS} heaps would be saved and the rest lost: pour it out first.
LanguageData.PhobosBulk_EndGone: What it poured into is gone.
LanguageData.PhobosBulk_EndNoRoom: There is no more room for what it holds.
LanguageData.PhobosBulk_EndGroundFull: There is no free ground left beside it.
LanguageData.PhobosBulk_OutOfReach: {OTHER} is out of reach: it must stand within {CELLS} cells of {HOLD}.
LanguageData.PhobosBulk_NoRoom: {OTHER} has no room for anything {HOLD} holds.
LanguageData.PhobosBulk_StandStill: {VEHICLE} must stand still to pour or be poured into.
LanguageData.PhobosBulk_NotOnMap: {VEHICLE} can only pour while it stands on a map.
LanguageData.PhobosBulk_SpillLost: {HOLD} is gone. What it held spilled over the ground, and the rest was lost: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.PhobosBulk_Spoiled: Some of what {HOLD} held has spoiled and is lost: {WHAT}.
LanguageData.PhobosBulk_LineAired: Air is blowing through it: it keeps longer.
LanguageData.PhobosBulk_LineNotAired: No power for its fan: it keeps no longer than in the open.
LanguageData.PhobosBulk_GizmoLoadDesc: {HOLD} takes in loose grain or seed lying within {CELLS} cells of it through its auger, as a farmer augers grain up from a heap. Haul the stacks next to it first, then choose what to take in.
LanguageData.PhobosBulk_NothingInReach: No loose grain or seed lies within {CELLS} cells of {HOLD}. Haul some next to it first.
LanguageData.PhobosBulk_LoadStarted: {HOLD} is taking in {WHAT} from the ground.
